heroHeadline: India Hosts BRICS Summit, Modi Frames Gathering as Test of Strategic Autonomy
heroSubtitle: India hosted the BRICS summit with Prime Minister Modi framing it as a demonstration of strategic autonomy as India navigates relationships with both Western and non-Western blocs amid US-Iran tensions and global tariff pressures. The summit underscores India's positioning as a bridge between competing geopolitical spheres ahead of the September 12-13 New Delhi Leaders' Summit.
footerNote: Data sourced from official BRICS declarations, NDB annual reports, IMF, UNCTAD, and major international outlets. Source tiers reflect editorial confidence levels.
